summary: Add dedicated Beta Roadmap section to SPEC.md documenting the 10 prioritized epics and work items required for beta feature completeness, based on current-state analysis (stubs, design docs #142/#143/#145, recent PRs, active Epic #218, etc.).
migration_impact: No migration required for downstream PLATE repositories or adopters. This is a pure documentation update to the product vision and roadmap guidance in SPEC.md; it does not change any runtime behavior, templates, CLI/MCP surfaces, or process rules.
migration_guidance: 1. Fetch the latest SPEC.md (or re-clone template) to see the new ## Beta Roadmap section.
2. Reference the listed items when creating follow-on Epics/Features (each will need its own milestone linkage, tests, fragments, and PRs per AGENTS.md).
3. Agents and humans should align new work proposals against this section in addition to the North Star and Goals.
agent_notes: Consult the new Beta Roadmap section in SPEC.md before proposing or starting implementation work on the core loops (planning, Q&A/Contemplation, release, config, health enforcement, E2E, catalog, observability). Items directly address gaps such as the plate_plan_epic stub (mcp_server.py), v1 Contemplation heuristics (contemplation.py), missing .plate CLI surfaces, and incomplete release automation. This snapshot was synthesized post-Information Audit Epic #218 landing and should be revisited on future releases.
